sources.label: USDFC conditional FIL redemption and partial fills

reserveReview.rationale: The issuer overview identifies native FIL as the sole permitted collateral, corroborated by fresh ActivePool and DefaultPool reads. The exact ActivePool source key binds the live adapter's collateral category. Redemption releases FIL subject to collateral-ratio and partial-redemption restrictions; neither those rules nor native transfer speed establishes a whole-position final USD liquidity maximum.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: FIL-only protocol rules, corroborated at Filecoin block 6458485 (2026-10-15T10:42:30Z): ActivePool 409845.981164685061058534 FIL plus DefaultPool 0.000000000000127749 FIL; entire-system debt and token totalSupply both 217964.428512163127719810 USDFC. Composition is 100% FIL, distinct from collateralization and executable redemption capacity.
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: No undisclosed collateral asset in the permitted single-asset book; FIL volatility and pool balances remain variable. FIL has no dedicated reserve-risk mapping; medium is the conservative native-altcoin classification.

nonLinkDispositions.rationale: Filecoin native collateral is not a tracked stablecoin.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: Pinned ActivePool and DefaultPool balances and protocol rules establish on-chain technical custody. Filecoin is the deployment network, not a legal jurisdiction. Legal segregation, insolvency priority and rehypothecation protections are not established.
